pitch_detail.notes: Compact lower rock band, simul-climbed with long runouts, to the right side of the big snowfield.
Traverse left across the snowfield to the foot of the couloir.
Belayed: iced-up slabs, then a steep chockstone.
Long, exposed couloir to the cornices and the summit ridge near 6,700 ft.
Hannegan Pass, Chilliwack ford, Easy Ridge, Imperfect Impasse to Perfect Pass camp (6,200 ft)
North from Perfect Pass toward the col in the summit ridge
Final ~100 ft to the col/summit ridge; protection recommended
From the Cinderella-Little Sister col, follow the jagged ridge crest on exposed low-5th-class rock.
Continue the ridge onto looser, broader rock higher on the mountain.
Pick through 4th-class blocks to the true summit.
Either of two clean corners/dihedrals to the ridge crest, then move right on chickenheads and good face features.
The route's memorable crux: a traverse across the exposed 'cannonhole' gap.
Short wall from the base up to a broad ledge.
Leftward to a steep black-rock dihedral; the uppermost ~15 ft is exposed 5.6 on solid granite.
Scramble through a distinctive reddish-black basalt dike.
20-ft downclimb followed by a rightward traverse across steep, well-broken rock.
Series of short chimneys and cracks up to Class 5.5 leading to the ridge crest, near a large horn with rappel slings.
Wildly exposed but generally solid scrambling over granite boulders to the summit.
